deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics and no derivation. It is an editorial table of contents, a plan for sorting Riemann's natural-philosophical fragments by the page numbers (S.) and sheet numbers (Blatt) of the manuscript bundle. It was most likely drafted by the editor(s) of Riemann's Gesammelte Werke (Dedekind/Weber, 1876) while preparing the 'Fragmente philosophischen Inhalts'.

The plan has three headings.

I. (Naturphilosophisches / Erkenntnistheoretisches)
(1) Grundbegriffe der Mathematik und Physik: S. 7-10 (on the formation of scientific concepts), S. 1-3, S. 10 bottom and 11 (Blatt 8), S. 45 (on the role of hypothesis in natural science), S. 38-40 (Blatt 16, 17; conditions of knowledge of nature).
(2) Molecularmechanik: S. 3-7 (Blatt 3, 4) and S. 31/32 (marked #, on the hypothesis of the space-filling substance).
(3) Gravitation und Licht: S. 11-21, 32-36, 44 (bottom)-45.

II. Psychologisches: S. 24-26, supplemented by S. 23 (Blatt 13); S. 26-31; S. 45 # to the end or to the mark X.

III. (… - Metaphysisches): S. 40-44. A bracketed note says S. 36-38 (Blatt 15) is omitted because it is printed complete in 'Bd. 18'.

The small pencil numbers 1-14 in the margin give a running order for the pieces.

This structure matches the published arrangement in the Werke: 'Zur Psychologie und Metaphysik', 'Erkenntnisstheoretisches', and 'Naturphilosophie' with the subsections Molecularmechanik, Neue mathematische Principien der Naturphilosophie, and Gravitation und Licht.

The sheet is the reverse of a printed Heidelberg doctoral diploma. It was issued to a 'Henricum … Moeno-Francofurtanum' (a Henricus from Frankfurt am Main). That is consistent with editorial paper reuse rather than Riemann's own hand.

Nothing is computed and no problem is solved.

results.what: Editorial ordering/table of contents of Riemann's natural-philosophy fragments (Molecular mechanics, Gravitation and light, Psychology, Metaphysics) by manuscript page
results.modern_name: Editorial plan for 'Fragmente philosophischen Inhalts' in Riemann's Gesammelte Werke
results.usually_credited_to: Editors of Riemann's Werke (R. Dedekind, H. Weber), 1876

deep.surprise_reason: Purely archival/editorial page listing manuscript page ranges under thematic headings; no mathematical or physical content, and the arrangement corresponds to the published Werke.
transcription_corrections: Heading I is probably 'Naturphilosophisches' (or similar), not 'Erkenntnißtheoretisches'. Its subsections are mathematics/physics, molecular mechanics and gravitation/light; the first word appears to begin 'Nat…'.
Heading III appears to read '… – Metaphysisches' (cf. Werke 'Zur Psychologie und Metaphysik') rather than 'Ideenwelt – Naturphilosophie'.

Under I.2, 'S. 31' carries a superscript correction to '32'. The parenthetical seems to concern the hypothesis of the space-filling substance ('Weltraum füllenden Stoffes'), not 'physischen Atome d. Gravitationstheorie'.
'S. 1-3' has small corrections ('2', '3') written above the numbers. The small numerals 1-14 in the margin are a running sequence for the pieces, not page numbers.
The parenthetical after S. 1-3 is uncertain; 'Antinomien' is doubtful.
The parenthetical after S. 45 likely begins 'Bedeutung der Hypothesen…'; the reading is plausible but uncertain.
In II, the parenthetical after S. 26-31 is uncertain; 'Gedanken' is doubtful.
The text after 'S. 45 #' reads 'bis zum Schluss oder bis X' with a crossed mark.
